description: List attachments on a release. Returns a response envelope {attachments, page, limit, count, has_next}. has_next true means a further page may exist; re-issue the call with page incremented to fetch it. The Forgejo API does not paginate this endpoint server-side, so the response is fetched in full and then sliced client-side; large attachment sets are still fully transferred from Forgejo before slicing.
name: list_release_attachments
